name: Screensavers
description:
Run classic X11 screensavers on GNOME Wayland, shown over the lock screen until the screen blanks. Made for a love of Flurry, the screensaver from macOS: XScreenSaver's port of the original Flurry is the default, and any of its roughly 250 other screensavers (or your own program) can run instead. The X11 savers run unmodified through Xwayland and never receive input; a key press or click stops them and shows the unlock prompt.

Requires the xscreensaver package (only its screensaver programs are used, not its daemon). Runs in the unlock-dialog session mode because the lock screen is where the screensaver is shown.
